<b>Abrupt onset of fever</b>, <b>myalgia</b>, <b>headache</b>, <b>generalized weakness</b> ร่วมกับ URTI symptoms (incubation ~2 วัน); complications: <b>secondary bacterial pneumonia</b>, <b>Reye syndrome</b>; รักษาด้วย <b>neuraminidase inhibitor</b>	<b>Influenza virus (A, B)</b><div><small>Orthomyxoviridae · segmented (−)ssRNA</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Influenza</b> (ไข้หวัดใหญ่)</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td><b>Abrupt onset</b> of fever, <b>myalgia</b>, headache, generalized weakness + URTI symptoms</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td><b>Respiratory droplets</b> · Influenza A ติดได้ทั้ง <b>birds & mammals</b>; B, C: primarily humans</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td>Worldwide · seasonal epidemics; antigenic shift (Influenza A) → pandemics</td></tr></table><ul><li>Subtype ตาม <b>hemagglutinin (HA)</b> และ <b>neuraminidase (NA)</b>; Influenza B มี 2 clades: Yamagata, Victoria</li><li><b>Antigenic drift</b> = accumulation of point mutations · <b>Antigenic shift</b> = <b>reassortment</b> of genome segments (Influenza A ติดได้ทั้ง birds และ mammals)</li><li>Complications: secondary infection จาก <i>S. aureus</i>, <i>S. pneumoniae</i>; <b>pericarditis, myocarditis, myositis, rhabdomyolysis</b>, Reye syndrome, transverse myelitis, aseptic meningitis</li><li>Antivirals: <b>oseltamivir</b>, peramivir, zanamivir (NA inhibitors) · <b>baloxavir</b> (cap-dependent endonuclease inhibitor)</li><li><b>Rapid antigen detection tests (RADTs)</b> lack sensitivity เทียบกับ molecular assays</li></ul><small>Viral diseases 69 · หน้า 2–3</small>	PathogenDx::Viral::resp
เด็กเล็กมี URTI นำมา แล้วเกิด <b>barking cough</b> + <b>inspiratory stridor</b> = <b>croup (laryngotracheitis)</b> — เชื้อที่เป็นสาเหตุของ <b>nearly half of croup cases</b>	<b>Parainfluenza virus (PIV-1)</b><div><small>Paramyxoviridae · 4 species</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Croup</b> (laryngotracheitis) · bronchiolitis & pneumonia (PIV-3)</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td>URTI prodrome → <b>barking cough</b>, hoarseness, <b>inspiratory stridor</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">Sign</th><td>Inspiratory stridor; <b>steeple sign</b> (subglottic narrowing) on AP neck X-ray</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td>Respiratory droplets, direct contact</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td>Young children; severe LRTI in young children & elderly</td></tr></table><ul><li>Croup ส่วนใหญ่เกิดจาก <b>PIV-1</b> · <b>bronchiolitis & pneumonia</b> ส่วนใหญ่เกิดจาก <b>PIV-3</b></li><li>4 species; incubation 2–6 วัน; ~15% เป็น <b>LRTI</b> (มักในเด็ก)</li><li><b>Severe LRTI</b> ใน young children และ elderly</li><li>No targeted therapeutics → <b>supportive</b></li></ul><small>Viral diseases 69 · หน้า 4</small>	PathogenDx::Viral::resp
<b>Premature infant</b> มี tachypnea + <b>wheezing</b> = <b>bronchiolitis</b>; histo: <b>multinucleated syncytial giant cells</b> ที่มี <b>round pink intracytoplasmic inclusion</b>; high-risk infants ป้องกันด้วย <b>palivizumab</b>	<b>Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV)</b><div><small>Pneumoviridae · (−)ssRNA</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Bronchiolitis</b> / pneumonia in infants</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td>Rhinorrhea, cough → <b>tachypnea, wheezing</b>; most severe in premature infants</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">Sign</th><td>Wheezing, chest retractions, nasal flaring · histo: <b>syncytial giant cells</b> + intracytoplasmic inclusion</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td><b>Large droplets</b> from nasopharyngeal secretions</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td><b>Infants</b> (esp. premature), elderly, immunocompromised</td></tr></table><ul><li>รุนแรงที่สุดใน <b>premature newborns</b> (narrow terminal airways); elderly & immunocompromised ก็รุนแรงได้; reinfection พบบ่อยแต่เบากว่า</li><li>vs Adenovirus: RSV = <b>syncytia + intracytoplasmic inclusion</b> · Adenovirus = <b>smudge cell (intranuclear inclusion)</b> (MED28 ข้อ 1 เฉลย Adenovirus)</li><li>Tx: supportive + O<sub>2</sub>; <b>ribavirin</b> (aerosol/IV)</li></ul><small>Viral diseases 69 · หน้า 4–5</small>	PathogenDx::Viral::resp
Respiratory virus ที่ติดได้ <b>all age groups</b> ส่วนใหญ่ <b>asymptomatic</b> หรือ <b>self-limited URTI</b> แต่พบใน <b>13% of severe LRTIs</b> ในเด็กที่ต้อง admit (US); no targeted therapeutics	<b>Human metapneumovirus (hMPV)</b><div><small>Pneumoviridae (closely related to RSV)</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td>URTI → severe LRTI in children</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td>Mostly <b>asymptomatic / self-limited URTI</b>; bronchiolitis, pneumonia in children</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td>Respiratory droplets</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td>All age groups · 13% of severe pediatric LRTIs requiring hospitalization (US)</td></tr></table><ul><li>Healthy children & adults: commonly asymptomatic หรือ self-limited URTI</li><li>Tx: <b>supportive</b></li></ul><small>Viral diseases 69 · หน้า 5</small>	PathogenDx::Viral::resp
<b>Common cold</b>: <b>pronounced watery nasal discharge</b> หลัง incubation 2–3 วัน; common complications: <b>acute otitis media</b> และ <b>sinusitis</b>	<b>Rhinovirus</b><div><small>Picornaviridae</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Common cold</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td><b>Pronounced watery nasal discharge</b> (incubation 2–3 days); complications: acute otitis media, sinusitis</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td>Respiratory droplets, hand contact (fomites)</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td>Worldwide — most common respiratory virus; Rhinovirus C → severe LRTI in young children, elderly, asthma</td></tr></table><ul><li><b>Most common cause</b> ของ respiratory viral infections ทั่วโลก</li><li><b>Rhinovirus C</b> → <b>severe LRTI</b> ใน young children, elderly, immunocompromised และ underlying lung disease เช่น <b>asthma</b></li></ul><small>Viral diseases 69 · หน้า 6</small>	PathogenDx::Viral::resp
<b>Outbreak</b> ใน <b>boarding school dormitory / military recruits / swimming pool</b>: low-grade fever + <b>pharyngitis</b> + <b>bilateral follicular conjunctivitis</b> + rhinitis, <b>preauricular lymphadenopathy</b>	<b>Adenovirus</b><div><small>Adenoviridae · dsDNA, non-enveloped</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Pharyngoconjunctival fever</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td>Low-grade fever + <b>pharyngitis</b> + <b>conjunctivitis</b> + rhinitis</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">Sign</th><td><b>Bilateral follicular conjunctivitis</b> + <b>preauricular lymphadenopathy</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td><b>Aerosolized droplets</b> or <b>direct conjunctival inoculation</b> (pool water)</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td><b>Crowded populations</b>: boarding school, summer camp, <b>swimming pool</b>, military recruits</td></tr></table><ul><li><b>Keratoconjunctivitis (pink eye)</b> with or without URTI symptoms</li><li>Important cause of <b>childhood diarrhea</b> (<b>species F, types 40 & 41</b>)</li><li>Vulnerable patients → <b>severe pneumonia</b></li></ul><small>Viral diseases 69 · หน้า 6 · ★ โจทย์เก่า MED29 ข้อ 10</small>	PathogenDx::Viral::resp MED29-10
เด็ก 2 ปี low-grade fever, rhinorrhea, tachypnea, <b>wheezing</b>; biopsy: <b>necrotizing bronchiolitis</b> + epithelial cells มี <b>large basophilic intranuclear inclusions</b> ที่บดบัง nuclear border (<b>smudge cells</b>)	<b>Adenovirus</b><div><small>Adenoviridae · dsDNA, non-enveloped</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Necrotizing bronchiolitis</b> / pneumonia</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td>Low-grade fever, rhinorrhea, <b>tachypnea, wheezing</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">Sign</th><td>Histo: <b>smudge cells</b> (basophilic intranuclear inclusion)</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td>Aerosolized droplets</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td>Young children; severe pneumonia in vulnerable / immunocompromised patients</td></tr></table><ul><li><b>Smudge cell</b> = <b>basophilic intranuclear inclusion</b> ± multinucleated giant cells</li><li>vs <b>RSV</b>: syncytial cells + <b>intracytoplasmic</b> inclusions</li><li>vs <b>CMV</b>: <b>cytomegaly</b> + <b>owl’s eye intranuclear inclusion</b> + perinuclear halo</li></ul><small>Viral diseases 69 · หน้า 6 · โจทย์เก่า · ★ โจทย์เก่า MED28 ข้อ 1</small>	PathogenDx::Viral::resp MED28-1
Cough, headache, myalgia + <b>loss of smell / taste (anosmia, ageusia)</b> ± diarrhea; severe: pneumonia, <b>ARDS</b>, <b>thromboembolic events</b>, <b>MIS-C</b> (Kawasaki-like); lab: <b>lymphopenia</b>, ↑CRP, ↑procalcitonin ในรายรุนแรง	<b>SARS-CoV-2</b><div><small>Coronaviridae · crown-like spikes on EM</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>COVID-19</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td>Headache, myalgia, <b>cough</b>, sore throat, diarrhea, <b>anosmia / ageusia</b>; severe: pneumonia, hypoxia, ARDS</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">Sign</th><td>Hypoxia + abnormal CXR; children: <b>MIS-C</b> (Kawasaki-like)</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td><b>Droplets</b>, direct contact, <b>aerosol</b>; possible fecal-oral and animal-to-human</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td>Worldwide; severe in elderly, DM, CKD, cardiovascular disease, COPD, obesity</td></tr></table><ul><li>Incubation เฉลี่ย <b>5–6 days</b> (>97% มีอาการภายใน 14 วัน); ~40% asymptomatic; severe (pneumonia, hypoxia) 15–20%</li><li><b>R0</b>: original strain 2.5 · Delta ~7 · Omicron ~10</li><li>Risk of severe disease: elderly, DM, CKD, cardiovascular disease, COPD, obesity (BMI ≥30)</li><li>Human coronaviruses 7 strains — 4 strains ทำให้ common cold (NL63, 229E, OC43, HKU1)</li></ul><small>Viral diseases 69 · หน้า 50–52</small>	PathogenDx::Viral::resp
เด็ก <b>unimmunized</b> มี high fever + <b>3Cs: cough, coryza, conjunctivitis</b> → <b>Koplik spots</b> (white punctate papules บน buccal mucosa ตรง lower molars) → <b>maculopapular rash</b> เริ่มที่ face / behind the ears แล้ว <b>coalesces and spreads downwards</b> สู่ trunk & extremities	<b>Measles virus (Measles morbillivirus)</b><div><small>Paramyxoviridae (Morbillivirus) · enveloped (−)ssRNA</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Measles</b> (หัด, rubeola)</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td>High fever + <b>3Cs</b> (cough, coryza, conjunctivitis) → maculopapular rash</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">Sign</th><td><b>Koplik spots</b> (buccal mucosa opposite lower molars) · rash starts <b>face / behind the ears → spreads downward</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td><b>Respiratory droplets & aerosol</b> (highly contagious)</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td>Unimmunized children; severe in <b>vitamin A deficiency</b>, malnutrition, immunocompromised</td></tr></table><ul><li>Highly contagious: ~<b>90%</b> of susceptible contacts infected; respiratory droplets & aerosol; <b>incubation 11–13 days</b></li><li>Histo: <b>Warthin-Finkeldey giant cells</b> (eosinophilic intranuclear + intracytoplasmic inclusions) ใน lymph node / sputum</li><li>Complications: <b>giant cell pneumonia</b>, diarrhea, encephalitis (APME, MIBE, <b>SSPE</b> — ได้ถึง 15 ปีหลังติด), <b>keratitis / blindness</b> (vitamin A deficiency)</li><li>Dx: <b>serum IgM</b> (sens 91% วันที่ 0–3 หลัง rash → 100% เมื่อ >7 วัน), <b>RT-PCR</b> (throat/NP swab, urine, serum)</li><li>Tx: supportive + <b>vitamin A supplementation</b> + treat secondary bacterial infection</li></ul><small>Viral diseases 69 · หน้า 8–10 · ★ โจทย์เก่า MED23 ข้อ 10</small>	PathogenDx::Viral::kids MED23-10
<b>Fine pink-red non-coalescing maculopapular rash</b> เริ่มที่ face & neck ลามทั่วตัวใน 24 ชม. และหายใน <b>3 days</b>; <b>Forchheimer spots</b> บน soft palate; ถ้าแม่ติดใน <b>first trimester</b> → ทารกมี <b>cataracts + sensorineural hearing loss + cardiac defects</b>	<b>Rubella virus</b><div><small>Matonaviridae (เดิม Togaviridae) · enveloped (+)ssRNA</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Rubella</b> (หัดเยอรมัน, German measles, three-day measles) · <b>congenital rubella syndrome</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td>Mild fever + <b>fine pink non-coalescing rash</b> (face → trunk ใน 24 ชม., หายใน 3 days)</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">Sign</th><td><b>Forchheimer spots</b> (soft palate), postauricular lymphadenopathy · CRS: <b>cataracts, SNHL, cardiac defects</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td>Direct / <b>droplet contact</b> with nasopharyngeal secretions · <b>transplacental</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td>Non-immune pregnant women — first trimester (~85% defects) · TORCH</td></tr></table><ul><li>Maternal infection มัก <b>mild & nonspecific</b>; birth defects สูงสุดเมื่อติดใน <b>first trimester (~85%)</b></li><li><b>Congenital rubella syndrome (CRS)</b>: <b>SGA</b> + <b>cataracts, SNHL, cardiac defects</b></li><li>No effective antiviral; CRS → supportive care</li></ul><small>Viral diseases 69 · หน้า 10–11</small>	PathogenDx::Viral::kids
Infant / young child มี <b>high fever</b> หลายวัน แล้วเมื่อ <b>fever subsides</b> จึงเกิด <b>nonpruritic blanching macular / maculopapular rash</b> ที่เริ่มจาก <b>trunk</b> แล้วลามไป neck, face, extremities	<b>Human herpesvirus 6 (HHV-6; HHV-7 พบน้อยกว่า)</b><div><small>Herpesviridae (beta) · dsDNA</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Roseola infantum</b> (exanthem subitum, sixth disease)</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td><b>High fever 3–5 days</b> → <b>rash appears as fever subsides</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">Sign</th><td><b>Nonpruritic blanching macular rash</b> starting on the <b>trunk</b> → neck, face, extremities</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td>Saliva (oral secretions)</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td>Infants 6 months–2 years · reactivation in transplant recipients</td></tr></table><ul><li>Rash เริ่มที่ <b>trunk</b> แล้วลามออก (ต่างจาก measles ที่เริ่มที่ face แล้วลามลง)</li><li><b>Reactivation</b> ใน <b>transplant recipients</b> → posttransplantation fever, encephalitis, pneumonitis</li><li>Dx: <b>qPCR</b> ใน blood / CSF (quantitation ช่วยบอก clinical significance และ monitor treatment)</li></ul><small>Viral diseases 69 · หน้า 11–12</small>	PathogenDx::Viral::kids
เด็ก low-grade fever แล้วมี <b>“slapped-cheek” rash</b> (bright red confluent rash ที่แก้มทั้งสองข้าง) ตามด้วย <b>lacy reticular rash</b> ที่ trunk & extremities; ผู้ใหญ่มี <b>arthralgia</b>	<b>Parvovirus B19</b><div><small>Parvoviridae · ssDNA, non-enveloped</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Erythema infectiosum</b> (fifth disease)</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td>Low-grade fever → <b>slapped-cheek rash</b> → lacy rash on trunk & limbs; adults: <b>arthralgia</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">Sign</th><td><b>“Slapped-cheek”</b> confluent facial erythema + <b>lacy reticular rash</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td>Respiratory droplets · <b>transplacental</b> (hydrops fetalis) · blood products</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td>School-age children · target: <b>erythroid progenitor cells</b> (P antigen)</td></tr></table><ul><li>Tropism ต่อ <b>erythroid progenitor cells</b> (receptor: <b>P antigen</b>)</li><li>Hemolytic anemia → <b>transient aplastic crisis</b>; immunocompromised → <b>pure red cell aplasia</b> (BM: <b>giant pronormoblasts</b>)</li><li>Pregnancy → <b>hydrops fetalis</b>, fetal loss (TORCH: “Other”)</li></ul><small>Viral diseases 69 · หน้า 12–13</small>	PathogenDx::Viral::kids

<b>Acute hepatitis</b> (jaundice) หลัง <b>contaminated food / water (fecal-oral)</b> หรือ person-to-person spread; <b>chronic infection does not occur</b>, most cases <b>resolve spontaneously</b>; มี <b>monovalent vaccine</b> และ <b>postexposure prophylaxis</b> ภายใน 2 สัปดาห์	<b>Hepatitis A virus (HAV)</b><div><small>Picornaviridae · (+)ssRNA</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Hepatitis A</b> — acute viral hepatitis</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td>Fever, malaise, anorexia, nausea → <b>jaundice</b>, dark urine; self-limited</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">Sign</th><td><b>Jaundice</b>, tender hepatomegaly</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td><b>Fecal-oral</b>: contaminated food & water, person-to-person</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td>Travelers to endemic areas, outbreaks (daycare, food handlers); <b>no chronic infection</b></td></tr></table><ul><li>Dx: <b>anti-HAV IgM</b> detectable at <b>onset of symptoms</b>; <b>anti-HAV IgG</b> ~2 สัปดาห์ postexposure</li><li>Only <b>0.5% of all viral hepatitis mortality</b></li><li>PEP: <b>hepatitis A vaccine</b> (± HAV-specific Ig) ภายใน 2 สัปดาห์ ในอายุ ≥12 เดือน</li></ul><small>Viral diseases 69 · หน้า 41–42</small>	PathogenDx::Viral::liver

Hepatotropic virus ที่ <b>progression to chronicity</b> ขึ้นกับ <b>age at infection / host immune maturity</b>: neonates ~90% vs adults ~5%; <b>oncogenic → hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC)</b>; transmission: <b>vertical, sexual, IV drug use</b>; mean incubation 90 วัน	<b>Hepatitis B virus (HBV)</b><div><small>Hepadnaviridae · DNA, oncogenic</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Hepatitis B</b> → chronic infection, cirrhosis, <b>HCC</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td>Acute: jaundice, RUQ pain (incubation ~90 days); chronic: often asymptomatic</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">Sign</th><td>Chronicity by age: <b>neonate ~90%</b> vs adult ~5%</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td><b>Vertical</b> (mother-to-child), horizontal (childhood), <b>sexual</b>, <b>IVDU</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td>Endemic in Asia & Africa · HBV-exposed infants → HBIG + vaccine at birth</td></tr></table><ul><li>Childhood infection → chronic ได้ถึง <b>95%</b> · adulthood <b>3–5%</b></li><li>HBV-exposed infant: <b>HBIG within 12 hours of birth</b></li><li>Chronic HBV Tx: <b>tenofovir</b>, <b>entecavir</b>, telbivudine; acute → supportive</li><li><b>HBV genotype</b>: prognosis & therapeutic management</li></ul><small>Viral diseases 69 · หน้า 43–46 · ★ โจทย์เก่า MED29 ข้อ 7</small>	PathogenDx::Viral::liver MED29-7
หญิง asymptomatic ติด HBV <b>perinatally</b>: <b>HBsAg (+), HBeAg (+)</b>, <b>HBV DNA >10<sup>7</sup> IU/mL</b> แต่ <b>persistently normal ALT</b> และ <b>minimal inflammation / fibrosis</b> — อยู่ phase ใด?	<b>HBV — Immune-tolerant phase</b><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td>HBeAg-positive chronic infection (<b>immune-tolerant phase</b>)</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td>Asymptomatic</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">Sign</th><td>HBeAg+, very high HBV DNA, <b>normal ALT</b>, minimal inflammation / fibrosis</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td><b>Perinatal</b> acquisition</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td>Young patients infected at birth (endemic Asia)</td></tr></table><ul><li>Phase 1 <b>Immune tolerant</b>: HBeAg+, very high DNA, <b>normal ALT</b> (perinatal acquisition)</li><li>Phase 2 <b>Immune clearance</b>: HBeAg+, <b>↑ALT</b>, inflammation ± fibrosis</li><li>Phase 3 <b>Inactive carrier</b>: HBeAg− / anti-HBe+, DNA &lt;2,000 IU/mL, normal ALT</li><li>Phase 4 <b>HBeAg-negative chronic hepatitis</b> (reactivation): fluctuating DNA, ↑ALT</li><li>Phase 5 <b>HBsAg-negative / occult HBV</b>: anti-HBc+ ± anti-HBs+</li></ul><small>Viral diseases 69 · หน้า 45–46 · ★ โจทย์เก่า MED29 ข้อ 8</small>	PathogenDx::Viral::liver MED29-8
History <b>shared unsterile needles (IVDU)</b> 10 ปีก่อน; fatigue, anorexia, <b>RUQ discomfort</b>, <b>mild scleral icterus</b>; <b>anti-HAV IgM (−)</b>, <b>HBsAg (−)</b>, <b>anti-HBs (+) / anti-HBc (−)</b> (= HBV vaccinated); <b>detectable serum viral RNA</b>	<b>Hepatitis C virus (HCV)</b><div><small>Flaviviridae · (+)ssRNA</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Hepatitis C</b> → chronic hepatitis, cirrhosis, HCC</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td>Often asymptomatic; fatigue, anorexia, RUQ discomfort, mild jaundice</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">Sign</th><td>Mild scleral icterus; <b>55–85% become chronic</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td><b>Percutaneous</b> (IVDU, shared needles, transfusion) > sexual, vertical</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td>IVDU, recipients of unscreened blood, hemodialysis patients</td></tr></table><ul><li><b>55–85% → chronic infection</b>; 20–30% → <b>cirrhosis</b> ใน 30 ปี; <b>HCC</b> 1–4% ต่อปี</li><li>Dx: <b>anti-HCV (+)</b> (โจทย์ให้มาด้วย) → confirm ด้วย <b>HCV RNA</b> หรือ <b>core antigen</b>; genotype → treatment planning</li><li>Tx: <b>direct-acting antivirals (DAAs)</b> → <b>SVR</b> (undetectable viral load 12 สัปดาห์หลังจบยา)</li></ul><small>Viral diseases 69 · หน้า 47 · ★ โจทย์เก่า MED25 ข้อ 18</small>	PathogenDx::Viral::liver MED25-18

เด็ก &lt;5 ปี, incubation ~2 wk: <b>catarrhal stage</b> (mild coughing, sneezing) → <b>paroxysmal stage</b>: explosive cough with <b>“whoop”</b>, <b>vomiting</b>, <b>cyanosis</b>, convulsion	<b><i>Bordetella pertussis</i></b><div><small>Gram− <b>coccobacilli</b> · Regan-Lowe / Bordet-Gengou medium</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Pertussis</b> (whooping cough, ไอกรน)</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td>Catarrhal stage (mild cough, sneezing) → <b>paroxysmal cough</b> with “whoop”, post-tussive vomiting</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">Sign</th><td><b>Inspiratory whoop</b>, cyanosis; marked <b>lymphocytosis</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td><b>Respiratory droplets</b> (incubation ~2 weeks)</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td>Children &lt;5 years — unimmunized infants most severe</td></tr></table><ul><li><i>B. parapertussis</i> → similar disease</li><li><b>Laryngotracheobronchitis</b>: mucosal erosion, hyperemia, copious mucopurulent exudate</li><li>Rarely: fatal <b>encephalitis</b></li><li>Culture: <b>Regan-Lowe (RL)</b> / Bordet-Gengou medium</li></ul><small>Bacterial disease 69 · หน้า 25, 28</small>	PathogenDx::Bacteria::resp

<b>Human bite</b> wound infection (รวม <b>clenched-fist injury</b>) — oral Gram− bacillus ที่มักพบร่วมกับ <b>anaerobes, streptococci, staphylococci</b>	<b><i>Eikenella corrodens</i></b><div><small>Gram− bacillus · HACEK</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Human bite infection</b> · clenched-fist injury · HACEK endocarditis</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td>Pain, swelling, purulent discharge at a bite / knuckle wound</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">Sign</th><td>Cellulitis / septic arthritis of the <b>MCP joint</b> (fist fight)</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td><b>Human bite</b> (human oral flora) — mixed with anaerobes, strep, staph</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td>Hands (clenched-fist injury)</td></tr></table><ul><li>เป็นหนึ่งใน <b>HACEK</b> → infective endocarditis ได้</li></ul><small>Bacterial disease 69 · หน้า 45, 49</small>	PathogenDx::Bacteria::zoo

<b>Swimming in warm fresh water</b> → ไม่กี่วันต่อมา <b>fulminant meningoencephalitis</b> (rare but fatal); CSF เหมือน <b>bacterial meningitis</b> (↓glucose, ↑protein, ↑WBC) แต่พบ <b>trophozoites</b>	<b><i>Naegleria fowleri</i></b><div><small>Free-living ameba · trophozoite, flagellate, cyst forms</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Primary amebic meningoencephalitis</b> (PAM) — rare but fatal</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td>Days after swimming: severe headache, fever, vomiting, stiff neck → altered mental status, seizures, coma</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">Sign</th><td>Meningeal signs; CSF <b>like bacterial meningitis</b> (↓glucose, ↑protein, ↑WBC) + motile <b>trophozoites</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td>Water forced up the nose → <b>cribriform plate</b> → olfactory nerve → brain</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td><b>Warm fresh water</b> (ponds, lakes, hot springs, poorly chlorinated pools); healthy children & young adults</td></tr></table><ul><li>3 forms: <b>ameboid trophozoite</b>, <b>flagellate</b>, <b>cyst</b></li><li>Dx: trophozoites / cysts ใน <b>CSF</b>, PCR, tissue histology</li></ul><small>Parasitic infection · หน้า 1–2</small>	PathogenDx::Parasite::cns

กิน <b>raw freshwater fish</b> (ก้อยปลา, “koi pla”): <b>intractable watery diarrhea</b>, severe weight loss, peripheral edema จาก <b>protein-losing enteropathy</b> → cachexia / death; egg: <b>peanut-shaped</b>, <b>thick striated shell</b>, <b>flattened bipolar plugs</b>	<b><i>Capillaria philippinensis</i></b><div><small>Intestinal nematode (small bowel) · <b>peanut-shaped egg</b>, flattened bipolar plugs</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Intestinal capillariasis</b> — protein-losing enteropathy</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td><b>Chronic intractable watery diarrhea</b>, borborygmi, weight loss → cachexia, death</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">Sign</th><td><b>Edema</b> / ascites (hypoalbuminemia), cachexia</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td>Ingest <b>raw freshwater fish</b> (ก้อยปลา) with larvae; <b>autoinfection</b> · natural host: fish-eating birds</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td><b>Philippines</b> (northern Luzon), <b>Thailand</b> · adults in <b>small intestine</b></td></tr></table><ul><li><b>Autoinfection</b>: larvae reinvade intestinal mucosa</li><li>No lung migration</li></ul><small>Parasitic infection · หน้า 18–21 · ★ โจทย์เก่า MED23 ข้อ 20</small>	PathogenDx::Parasite::nema MED23-20
Ingest <b>undercooked pork</b> / eggs → <b>cysticercosis</b> (cysts ใน muscle / brain); <b>scolex with suckers and hooks</b>; gravid proglottid มี <b>fewer uterine branches</b> กว่า beef tapeworm	<b><i>Taenia solium</i></b><div><small>Cestode · scolex with <b>suckers + hooks</b> · gravid proglottid: few uterine branches</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Taeniasis</b> (pork tapeworm, พยาธิตืดหมู) · <b>cysticercosis / neurocysticercosis</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td>Taeniasis: mild GI upset · neurocysticercosis: <b>seizures</b>, headache, hydrocephalus</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">Sign</th><td>Brain imaging: cysts with a <b>scolex</b>, calcified cysts; subcutaneous nodules</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td>Undercooked <b>pork</b> (cysticerci) → taeniasis · ingest <b>eggs</b> (fecal-oral, autoinfection) → cysticercosis</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td>Pig-raising areas with poor sanitation · adult in <b>small intestine</b>; cysts in <b>brain, muscle, eye</b></td></tr></table><ul><li><b>Cysticercosis = pig tapeworm</b> (จุดที่ไฮไลต์ในชีท)</li><li><b>Cysticercus</b> = pea-sized fluid-filled bladder with an <b>invaginated scolex</b></li><li>Adults ใน <b>small intestine</b>; eggs & proglottids ใน feces หลัง ≥2 เดือน</li><li>Dx: <b>proglottids / eggs in stool</b> (repeated, concentration techniques), <b>serology</b> (<i>T. solium</i>), coproantigen, PCR</li></ul><small>Parasitic infection · หน้า 24–25</small>	PathogenDx::Parasite::cest ไฮไลต์ในชีท
Ingest <b>uncooked beef</b> containing <b>cysticerci</b> (ลาบ / ก้อยเนื้อ) → adult worm ใน small intestine: N/V, abdominal pain, diarrhea (or asymptomatic); <b>proglottids passed in stool</b>	<b><i>Taenia saginata</i></b><div><small>Cestode · scolex <b>without hooks</b> · gravid proglottid: many uterine branches</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Taeniasis</b> (beef tapeworm, พยาธิตืดวัว)</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td>Often asymptomatic; mild abdominal discomfort, N/V; passing motile proglottids</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">Sign</th><td>Motile <b>proglottids</b> in stool / crawling out of the anus; <b>no cysticercosis</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td>Ingest <b>raw / undercooked beef</b> with cysticerci (ลาบ / ก้อยเนื้อ)</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td>Beef-eating areas — <b>Northern & Northeastern Thailand</b> · adult in <b>small intestine</b></td></tr></table><ul><li>Scolex: <b>no hooks</b>; gravid proglottid มี uterine branches <b>more</b> กว่า pork tapeworm</li><li><b>No human cysticercosis</b></li></ul><small>Parasitic infection · หน้า 24–25</small>	PathogenDx::Parasite::cest
<b>Dwarf tapeworm</b> — <b>most frequently found tapeworm in the US</b>; <b>eggs directly infectious → autoinfection</b>; หรือ ingest <b>cysticercoids</b> ใน intermediate hosts (<b>flea, grain beetles</b>)	<b><i>Hymenolepis nana</i></b><div><small>Cestode · egg with <b>polar filaments</b> · intermediate host not required</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Hymenolepiasis</b> (dwarf tapeworm)</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td>Mostly asymptomatic; abdominal pain, diarrhea, anorexia</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td>Ingest <b>eggs</b> directly (fecal-oral, <b>autoinfection</b>) or cysticercoids in <b>fleas, grain beetles</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td><b>Children</b>, institutions; most common tapeworm in the US · small intestine</td></tr></table><ul><li>Asymptomatic หรือ <b>GI distress</b></li><li>Dx: <b>eggs in stool</b> — <i>H. diminuta</i> eggs <b>2× larger</b> and <b>lack polar filaments</b></li></ul><small>Parasitic infection · หน้า 25</small>	PathogenDx::Parasite::cest ไฮไลต์ในชีท

<b>Outbreak after an outdoor banquet</b> (fresh produce) ~7 วันต่อมา: <b>watery diarrhea</b>, abdominal cramps, fatigue, low-grade fever; modified AFB: <b>round oocysts 8–10 µm</b> with <b>variable acid-fast staining</b> + <b>autofluorescence under UV</b>	<b><i>Cyclospora cayetanensis</i></b><div><small>Apicomplexa · oocyst <b>8–10 µm</b>, variable acid-fast, <b>autofluorescent</b></small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Cyclosporiasis</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td>Prolonged <b>watery diarrhea</b>, cramps, fatigue, low-grade fever, weight loss</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td><b>Contaminated fresh produce</b> (berries, lettuce, herbs) & water — oocysts must sporulate outside the host</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td>Food-borne outbreaks (banquets), travelers to tropics · small intestine</td></tr></table><ul><li>Oocyst size: <i>Cryptosporidium</i> 4–5 µm &lt; <b><i>Cyclospora</i> 8–10 µm</b> &lt; <i>Cystoisospora</i> 20–30 µm</li><li>Non-bloody diarrhea, <b>malabsorption</b>, weight loss, fatty stool; severe ใน immunocompromised / infants</li></ul><small>Parasitic infection · หน้า 32–33 · ★ โจทย์เก่า MED23 ข้อ 17</small>	PathogenDx::Parasite::proto MED23-17
